Imports

config, store, types, resolver

Types

InstalledRecord = object
  version*: string
  path*: string
  root*: bool

Vars

devShadowWarningsEnabled = false
Build commands enable this when --verbose is passed; the shadow warning would otherwise interleave with the live spinner line on a plain build.

proc allInstalledPaths(cfg: DatpkgrConfig): seq[string] {....raises: [Exception,
    StoreError, IOError, WalError, OSError, KeyError, CatchableError,
    ValueError, JsonParsingError, StorageError, KeyError, InvalidVersionError], tags: [
    RootEffect, ReadDirEffect, WriteIOEffect, ReadIOEffect, TimeEffect,
    WriteDirEffect, ExecIOEffect], forbids: [].}
One --path (install dir) per installed package — the latest version each — so import xyz / import pkg/xyz resolves for any clue-installed package. One path per package avoids Nim's ambiguity error from multiple versions. Non-semver records (HEAD for tagless repos, branch pins) track moving upstream, so they rank above any fixed semver version. Without this, tagless packages (sole HEAD record) vanish from every --path list and dependents fail with cannot open file even though they are installed.

True for develop-mode (editable) installs whose path points outside the package registry — i.e. at the user's own source tree. Such installs have no files under ~/.clue/packages; only their DB entry exists, and only the entry may ever be deleted.

Record an installed package version with its resolved dependencies. root marks packages the user explicitly installed (vs. pulled as deps); only roots survive pruning. features are the active feature set the package was resolved with (used to emit -d:features.<pkg>.<feat>). installPath is the directory the compiler gets via --path.
